blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: LAN — Network spanning a relatively small geographical area.
WAN — Network connecting networks over larger distances.
protocol — Agreed rules for communicating between systems.
standard — Shared specification that enables interoperability.

blocks.title: Identify scope
blocks.text: LAN connects local devices; WAN connects distant sites.

blocks.title: Interconnect devices
blocks.text: Switches connect local devices; routers forward traffic between networks.

blocks.title: Use open rules
blocks.text: Protocols and standards let different equipment communicate.
